correctness.rationale: The cap decomposition X_i=(S_i,sqrt(1-S_i²)U_i) yields sqrt(d) dot products = sqrt(d)S_iS_j+scaled tangent Gram. The fixed-k offdiagonal tangent Gram log-determinant density expansion has leading independent Gaussian edges and first 1/sqrt(d) triangle-cubic term. For exact height h=λd^-1/4, the scaled radial overshoot tends to independent exponentials of mean1, producing boundary shift coefficient 2+λ⁴; for h=a/sqrt(d), normal-truncated radial mean μ_a yields coefficient μ_a². Integrating shifted Gaussian edge thresholds gives L_H, and the cubic density gives T_H; all patterns normalize since signed single-edge and triangle sums vanish. When d^1/4 h→λ, radial mean yields independent edge probabilities Φ(λ²), including λ=0 and infinity. Independent exact signed pattern coefficient summations for k=3,4 and the source finite sampling checker were inspected, but these finite tests are not proofs of the uniform L1 remainder.
